_comment: Shared S2S v2 routePath registry (upgrade plan 5.0). IDENTICAL copies live in core tests/pooled/s2sRoutePaths.json and control plane api/tests/fixtures/s2sRoutePaths.json; each repo's s2sRoutePaths test asserts its own signers/verifiers use exactly these names. route = the string inside v2:{route}:...; tenantBound = whether the signed string ends with :{tenantWsId} (true always, false never, 'optional' when the signer binds a tenant only for pooled targets and the verifier binds whatever X-Rt-Workspace carries); direction = signer->verifier.

routes.note: GET; empty body hash; tenant = requesting workspace
tenant = completing workspace == task.targetWsId (pooled: the tenant, not the service id)

POST /api/internal/workspaces/:target/wake; tenant = REQUESTING workspace (CP reads the requester from the signature, the target from the URL); legacy X-Bridge-* alongside; in-pod k8s PATCH only under RT_LEGACY_INPOD_WAKE=true
tenant bound only when the target workspace is pooled
dedicated pods only; v2 hashes tool+args
pooled Arthur chat ingress; tenant required
